coupons.title: Special menus from $10 bites to full prix-fixe at 70+ spots
coupons.description: Visit Berkeley's 'Seeds of Spring' restaurant week features 70+ Berkeley restaurants, bars and wineries with deals from $10 bites to full prix-fixe menus, plus a 'Sips of Spring' complimentary corkage for Berkeley-made wine/sake. Held each spring (2026 ran April 2-12).

coupons.title: BOGO Boneless Thursdays + 50% off wing Tuesdays
coupons.description: Buy any size boneless wings, get the same size free every Thursday (everyone, takeout/delivery via app or site). Tuesdays, Blazin' Rewards members buy one traditional wing order and get a second of equal/lesser value 50% off.
coupons.eligibility: App/site; Tuesday deal for Blazin' Rewards

coupons.title: $3.98 Whopper Wednesday + free sign-up Whopper
coupons.description: Get a Whopper for $3.98 on Wednesdays through your Royal Perks account on the BK App or bk.com. New digital customers get a free Whopper, Croissan'wich, or Original Chicken Sandwich on their first order. Members also get a free Whopper on their birthday.

coupons.title: Free welcome item with $1+ purchase (My Rewards)
coupons.description: Join the free My Rewards program and get a free welcome item with any $1+ purchase. Members earn 10 Stars per $1 and the app Offers tab surfaces BOGO sandwiches and app-only combos. Redeem through the app or order.carlsjr.com.

coupons.title: 3 for Me: drink + appetizer + entrée from $10.99
coupons.description: The 3 For Me combo includes a non-alcoholic drink, a starter (chips & salsa, soup, or side salad), and a full-size entrée starting at $10.99. Available all day, every day. Base entrées like the Big Smasher Burger hit the $10.99 tier; mid-tier $14.99 and premium picks $16.99+.

coupons.title: Free chips & guac for new Rewards members ($5+ order)
coupons.description: New Chipotle Rewards members (free to join) get free chips and guac with a $5 minimum purchase. The app regularly drops member-only BOGO and free-side promos throughout the year - check the Offers tab.

coupons.title: Early Dinner Deals + Cracker Barrel Rewards
coupons.description: Early Dinner Deals are available weekdays roughly 4-6 PM for dine-in guests, alongside rotating Daily Specials. Join free Cracker Barrel Rewards to earn points toward food and retail plus a birthday treat.

coupons.title: Buy One Blizzard, Get One for 99¢ (app)
coupons.description: Buy one Blizzard Treat and get a second of equal or lesser value for 99 cents, redeemable in the DQ Mobile App for DQ Rewards members. Joining the Blizzard Fan Club also gets you six BOGO Blizzard coupons a year.

coupons.title: 2 free Del Tacos when you join Del Yeah! Rewards
coupons.description: Create and verify a free Del Yeah! Rewards account and get 2 free Del Tacos immediately. Earn 8-12 points per $1, and unlock member-only Wednesday Hookups deals each week in the app.

coupons.title: Kids Eat Free with adult entrée
coupons.description: Up to two free kids' entrées from the kids' menu per adult entrée purchase of $6 or more, typically Tuesdays 4-10 PM (days/participation vary by location). Join free Denny's Rewards for extra deals and a birthday treat.
coupons.eligibility: With $6+ adult entrée; varies by location

coupons.title: $45 three-course prix-fixe at 30+ downtown restaurants
coupons.description: Downtown Sacramento Partnership's annual Dine Downtown restaurant week: 30+ central-city restaurants (Dawson's Kitchen, The Firehouse, Ella, Frank Fat's, Revolution Winery & Kitchen) serve a 3-course prix-fixe dinner for $45 ($1 per meal donated to Opening Doors). Runs every January in downtown Sacramento.

coupons.title: Mix & Match: any 2+ items $6.99 each
coupons.description: Pick any 2 or more menu items - medium 2-topping pizzas, boneless chicken or wings, Stuffed Cheesy Bread, pastas, oven-baked sandwiches - for $6.99 each. Two-item minimum; carryout or delivery at participating locations. Usually applies automatically at checkout.

coupons.title: New app users: 50% off your first 3 app orders
coupons.description: New Domino's app users get 50% off their first three orders placed through the app. Offer applies in-app at checkout.

coupons.title: $0 delivery fee on your first order
coupons.description: New DoorDash customers automatically get $0 delivery fee on their first order (no code needed) at restaurants across SF, the Bay Area and Sacramento. DashPass members also get reduced/zero fees on eligible orders.

coupons.title: $6 Meal Deal: coffee + sandwich + hash browns
coupons.description: Bundle a medium hot or iced coffee, a breakfast sandwich, and an order of hash browns for $6. Join free Dunkin' Rewards to earn 10 points per $1 (free coffee at 600 points), plus weekly app Offers like bonus-point days and $1 coffees.

coupons.title: Tiered happy hour: 50% off drinks 4-5pm weekdays
coupons.description: Historic Mission saloon Elixir offers a sliding happy hour on a wide selection of drinks: 50% off 4-5pm, 30% off 5-6pm and 15% off 6-7pm, weekdays.

coupons.title: Loyalty signup - 50% off your first sandwich + free birthday treat
coupons.description: Northern California sandwich chain Erik's DeliCafé's app loyalty program gives 50% off your first sandwich at signup, a free bakery item or cup of soup for your birthday, and $10 back per 100 points (1 pt/$1). Bay Area, Santa Cruz and Central Coast locations.

coupons.title: Free unlimited toppings + bonus scoop of fries
coupons.description: Every burger and hot dog comes with 15+ free toppings (no upcharge), and in-store orders include a complimentary extra serving of fries scooped into the bag. The app occasionally pushes limited-time offers; no national coupon codes.

coupons.title: 5% cash back at Super Duper Burgers (Castro / Emeryville)
coupons.description: Groupon + Rewards Network cash-back dining deal: link a card and earn cash back (about 5%) on dine-in spend at Super Duper Burgers locations including the Castro (SF) and Emeryville (East Bay). No voucher needed.

coupons.title: Up to 70% off San Francisco restaurants
coupons.description: Groupon's San Francisco restaurants section lists discounted dining vouchers (up to 70% off) at local SF eateries - American, seafood, diners and dinner-and-entertainment deals across the city.

coupons.title: Kids Eat Free with adult entrée (4-10 PM)
coupons.description: Kids 12 and under get one free meal with each adult entrée, generally 4-10 PM at participating locations, dine-in only. Join free International Bank of Pancakes rewards for app deals and a welcome offer.
coupons.eligibility: With adult entrée; dine-in, varies by location

coupons.title: Half-off pizzas and appetizers happy hour, Mon-Fri 3-6pm
coupons.description: Midtown/Downtown Sacramento bar & grill: weekday happy hour Monday-Friday 3-6pm with half-off all pizzas and appetizers plus $3 off specialty cocktails.

coupons.title: 20% off when you join Jack Pack Rewards
coupons.description: Sign up for Jack in the Box Rewards and score 20% off your order, plus app-exclusive Jack Pack deals and 10 points per $1. Also live: the limited-time Hot Ones Munchie Meal (June 1-July 22) and the Munch Better Deals value menu from $7.

coupons.title: Free sub on birthday + free delivery in the app
coupons.description: Join MyMike's Rewards (or the email club) for a free birthday sub and earn Shore Points toward free subs. Ordering through the Jersey Mike's app gets you free delivery plus app-exclusive promo codes.

coupons.title: Free sandwich on first order with JJ Rewards
coupons.description: Sign up for the new JJ Rewards program and earn a free sandwich on your first order as a new member. Members earn 10 points per $1 toward free sandwiches, sides, drinks and desserts.

coupons.title: Free Bucket with $15+ online order (Rewards)
coupons.description: Get a Free Bucket On Us with a $15+ online purchase through a KFC Rewards account on KFC.com or the app at participating stores. Plus a $10 Tuesday bucket deal and a rotating Bucket of the Day Mon-Fri.

coupons.title: Buy any dozen, get an Original Glazed dozen for $2
coupons.description: Buy any regular-priced dozen and get an Original Glazed dozen for $2. Available in-shop and drive-thru (limit two); for online orders use code BOGO2 (limit one). Rewards members can redeem all weekend long.

coupons.title: Classic Pepperoni HOT-N-READY $5.55
coupons.description: Grab a classic pepperoni HOT-N-READY pizza for $5.55 any time during store hours, no order ahead needed. ExtraMostBestest pizzas run $7.99. Family bundle: large pizza + 10 wings + Crazy Bread for $19.99.

coupons.title: Happy hour: $2 oysters, $10 wine, $7 beer
coupons.description: Pacific Heights raw-bar spot Little Shucker offers a happy hour with $2 oysters (by the half-dozen or dozen), $10 glasses of wine and $7 beers.

coupons.title: Club 59 rewards + 15% military discount
coupons.description: Sonoma-founded Mary's Pizza Shack's free Club 59 rewards program earns points toward $5-off rewards with member-only deals and bonus gift cards; the chain also offers a 15% military discount to veterans/active duty with valid ID. Sonoma, Napa, Marin and North Bay locations.

coupons.title: Hora Feliz: $5 Modelo, $7 Maya Margarita, $8.50 taco flight
coupons.description: Downtown Sacramento Oaxacan restaurant: 'Hora Feliz' happy hour Monday-Friday 3-5pm with $5 Modelo, $7 Maya Margarita and discounted apps including an $8.50 taco flight.

coupons.title: McValue: $5 Meal Deal + Buy One, Add One for $1
coupons.description: The $5 Meal Deal includes a McDouble or McChicken, small fries, 4-pc McNuggets and a small drink. McValue also has Buy One, Add One for $1 (add an item of equal/lesser value). App drops free medium fries with a $1 purchase every Friday and a free sandwich for new app users.
coupons.eligibility: App for fries Friday & new-user freebie

coupons.title: Mountain Rewards app - $5 off your first order
coupons.description: Join Mountain Mike's Pizza Mountain Rewards via the mobile app to get $5 off your first order plus points on every purchase. Participating NorCal locations (select your store in the app). Locations are franchised so deals vary.

coupons.title: Triple Play bundle - large 1-topping pizza + 2 sides for $30
coupons.description: California-based Mountain Mike's Pizza Triple Play bundle: a large 1-topping pizza plus your choice of any two sides, salads, wings or desserts for ~$30, dine-in or carryout, Monday-Thursday only. Available at Bay Area, Sacramento and statewide locations (price varies by location).

coupons.title: Month-long prix-fixe menus and stay-and-dine deals across the valley
coupons.description: Visit Napa Valley's Restaurant Month (all of January) offers prix-fixe menus, stay-and-dine hotel bundles and specials across Napa, Yountville, St. Helena, Calistoga and American Canyon - from food trucks to Michelin tasting menus (e.g. Wilfred's Lounge 3-course for $35).

coupons.title: Nation's Rewards - BOGO burger when you join
coupons.description: Bay Area institution Nation's Giant Hamburgers & Great Pies (since 1952): join Nation's Rewards through the app to get a BOGO burger / free side offer, a free burger on your birthday, and a $5-off referral for you and a friend. East Bay, SF and Sacramento-area locations.

coupons.title: Prix-fixe lunch from $15 and dinner from $35 across Oakland
coupons.description: Visit Oakland's annual restaurant week features 135+ Oakland restaurants with lunch menus at $15/$25/$35 and dinner at $35/$45/$65, plus family-style and tasting specials. Held each spring (2026 ran March 12-22).

coupons.title: Aussie-style unlimited soup, salad & breadsticks
coupons.description: Unlimited Soup or Salad and breadsticks remains a year-round value at lunch. Note: the Never Ending Pasta Bowl ($13.99, unlimited pasta/sauce/soup or salad/breadsticks) runs as a seasonal promo starting Aug 25, and Buy One, Take One returns at select times - both dine-in only.

coupons.title: 1,000-Point bonus tables across the Bay Area
coupons.description: OpenTable offers 1,000-Point bonus reservations at participating San Francisco Bay Area restaurants (vs. the standard 100) - book those tables and redeem accumulated points for Dining Rewards/gift cards. Free OpenTable account required.

coupons.title: Special menus, prix-fixe & dining experiences in the Bay Area
coupons.description: OpenTable Experiences lists bookable special menus, multi-course prix-fixe deals and unique dining events at San Francisco Bay Area restaurants, including theater-district 3-course prix-fixe offers and business-lunch deals.

coupons.title: Aussie 3-Course Meal from $14.99
coupons.description: A three-course meal - soup or salad, a signature entrée, and a slice of New York-style cheesecake - starting at $14.99. Dine-in at participating locations. Walkabout Wednesday entrée deal also available at $13.99.

coupons.title: Weekday happy hour: $3-4 pizza slices + $13 Italian combo
coupons.description: Tenderloin pizzeria Outta Sight Pizza offers slices at $3-4 apiece during its weekday happy hour, plus discounted drinks and a $13 Italian combo sandwich.

coupons.title: Free entrée online + Pandaoke kit with Family Meal
coupons.description: Get a free entrée item when you order a Plate or A La Carte online at participating locations. During the spring/summer Pandaoke promotion, buy a Family Meal and receive a free Pandaoke karaoke kit (about a $15 value). New Panda Rewards users often get a free small entrée.

coupons.title: 50% off pizzas on carryout orders
coupons.description: Most locations automatically apply 50% off all menu-priced pizzas when you choose Carryout at checkout. Join free Papa Rewards to earn points toward free pizza.

coupons.title: Peetnik Rewards - free birthday drink + welcome bonus
coupons.description: Berkeley-founded Peet's Coffee Peetnik Rewards (free via app): get a free beverage on your birthday, 125 welcome points after your first purchase, and 25 bonus points on your sign-up anniversary. Bay Area and nationwide locations.

coupons.title: Sunday Sessions - wood-fired pizza & tacos with wine, $85 ($42.50 members)
coupons.description: PEJU winery in Rutherford (Napa Valley) hosts relaxed Sunday afternoon patio sessions May 10-Aug 30, 2026 with wood-fired pizzas, artisan tacos and rotating wine pairings for $85 per person, or $42.50 for wine club members.

coupons.title: Philz Rewards - free drink upgrade + 150 points at signup
coupons.description: Bay Area-born Philz Coffee's new Philz Rewards program (app only): get a free drink upgrade plus 150 bonus points just for signing up, earn 10 points per $1, and get a free drink of any size at 1,200 points, plus a birthday treat. Bay Area and statewide locations.

coupons.title: $2 Personal Pan Pizza Tuesdays + Hut Rewards
coupons.description: One-topping Personal Pan Pizzas for $2 each on Tuesdays (carryout, limit four). Join free Hut Rewards via the app to earn 2 points per $1, unlock app-only Hut Hook-Up offers, and get a birthday reward.

coupons.title: Current promotions & email/app-only deals
coupons.description: Pizza My Heart (Bay Area / Santa Cruz / Silicon Valley) posts rotating promotions on its site and sends promo codes and flash-sale deals to email and app subscribers - past deals include $7.50 off a large pizza with a salad. Sign up for newsletter to receive codes.

coupons.title: Early Week deal - large 1-topping pizza for $22 (Mon-Thu)
coupons.description: Surf-themed Bay Area chain Pizza My Heart's Early Week special: a large 1-topping pizza for $22, available Monday through Thursday. Locations from San Francisco and the Peninsula to Silicon Valley, Santa Cruz and the East Bay.

coupons.title: Free chicken on first app order ($10+) + $4.49 Tuesday 2-pc
coupons.description: New app customers get a free item (2-Pc Chicken, 3-Pc Tenders, 6-Pc Wings, Chicken Sandwich, or Fried Pickles) on their first order of $10+. Plus the consistent Tuesday 2-piece chicken meal for $4.49 nationwide.

coupons.title: Free Box Combo when you join the Caniac Club
coupons.description: Join the free Caniac Club, register your card, and get a free Box Combo welcome meal (typically activated within 48 hours). BOGO Box Combo offers also appear in the app around holidays like Father's Day.

coupons.title: Ultimate Endless Shrimp from $24.99
coupons.description: Endless Shrimp is back for a limited time - endless servings of Walt's Favorite Shrimp, Garlic Shrimp Scampi, Parrot Isle Coconut Shrimp, Shrimp Linguini Alfredo and new Marry Me Shrimp, starting at $24.99. Dine-in only at participating locations.

coupons.title: Special dining events & experiences in San Francisco
coupons.description: Resy's San Francisco events hub lists special dining events, collaboration dinners, tasting menus and ticketed experiences at SF and Oakland restaurants. Free Resy account required to book.

coupons.title: Royal Rewards - earn points toward free pizza
coupons.description: California-born Round Table Pizza's free Royal Rewards loyalty program (sign up on the app/site) earns 1 point per $1 spent toward food rewards, with member-only deals and a signup offer. Available at Bay Area, Sacramento and statewide locations.

coupons.title: Free-admission Farm-to-Fork Festival, Sept 13-28
coupons.description: Sacramento's annual Farm-to-Fork Celebration (Sept 13-28, 2026) is a two-week food event in America's Farm-to-Fork Capital; the festival weekend has free admission with hundreds of local food, wine and beer vendors. Terra Madre Americas runs Sept 26-28 at the SAFE Credit Union Convention Center.

coupons.title: 11 days of prix-fixe menus at ~50 downtown San Jose restaurants
coupons.description: San Jose Downtown Association's Dine Downtown restaurant week features nearly 50 downtown San Jose restaurants - from street food to Michelin-rated spots - with multi-course prix-fixe menus over 11 days.

coupons.title: Happy hour: everything $10 (margaritas, flautas, nachos)
coupons.description: Castro-district Mexican spot Santería runs a happy hour where everything is $10 - frozen margaritas, sangria and food specials like flautas, quesadillas and nachos.

coupons.title: Prix-fixe lunch from $10 and dinner from $30 citywide
coupons.description: San Francisco's twice-yearly restaurant week (GGRA): 200+ SF restaurants offer multi-course prix-fixe menus at set price points - brunch/lunch $10/$15/$25/$35/$45 and dinner $30/$45/$60/$75/$90. Spring 2026 ran April 10-19; fall edition typically returns in early November.

coupons.title: Free Crinkle Fries with $10 spend + 20% off first app order
coupons.description: Get free Crinkle Fries when you spend $10 via the Shake Shack app. New app users get 20% off their first order (up to $5, $20+ pickup/delivery), and Rewards members get Free Fries Fridays plus Challenge rewards like $10 off after two burger purchases.

coupons.title: Prix-fixe lunch and dinner at 100+ wine-country restaurants
coupons.description: Sonoma County's annual restaurant week brings 100+ restaurants across Santa Rosa, Petaluma, Healdsburg, Sonoma and beyond together with value prix-fixe lunch and dinner menus. Held each winter (2026 ran February 23-March 1).

coupons.title: 2-for-1 and free wine tasting coupons across Sonoma
coupons.description: Sonoma Tourist Guide compiles current 2-for-1 and complimentary wine-tasting deals at wineries and tasting rooms throughout Sonoma Valley and Sonoma County - useful for pairing with wine-country dining.

coupons.title: Weekly Social Hour - wines by the glass from $10
coupons.description: St. Supéry Estate Vineyards & Winery in Rutherford (Napa Valley) hosts a weekly casual 'Social Hour' with wines by the glass starting at just $10 - a low-key, lower-cost alternative to a formal tasting.

coupons.title: Free Mod Monday + app BOGO Happy Hour events
coupons.description: Every Starbucks Rewards member gets a free Mod Monday perk - one complimentary modifier added to any handcrafted drink, once per month. Starbucks also runs app-exclusive BOGO Happy Hour events (afternoons) for Rewards members announced through the app.

coupons.title: Rewards members: Double Star Days + app BOGO offers
coupons.description: Starbucks Rewards members get periodic Double Star Days (Gold/Reserve tiers see 4-6 per year) plus targeted in-app offers including BOGO drinks and bonus-Star challenges. Activate offers in the app before ordering.
coupons.eligibility: Starbucks Rewards members; activate in app

coupons.title: $5 / $7 / $9 drink specials every Wednesday across downtown
coupons.description: Seasonal summer happy-hour program from the Downtown Sacramento Partnership: participating bars and restaurants across downtown Sacramento offer drinks for $5, $7 and $9 every Wednesday from 4-7pm. Currently running through the summer.

coupons.title: Happy hour: free fries with a local beer, wine or shake (Mon-Fri 4-6pm)
coupons.description: Bay Area burger chain Super Duper's happy hour: buy a local Bay Area beer, wine or milkshake Monday-Friday 4-6pm and get a complimentary order of fresh fries. Locations across SF, the Peninsula and East Bay.

coupons.title: Loyalty signup - 10% off first order + birthday treat
coupons.description: Sign up for Super Duper Burgers' loyalty program on the website to get 10% off your first order, a birthday treat and member-only promotions. Bay Area locations (SF, Peninsula, East Bay).

coupons.title: Sweet Rewards - $7 off for you and a friend (referral)
coupons.description: Sweetgreen's Sweet Rewards: refer a friend and you both get $7 off; new customers also get a $5 credit on a first qualifying digital order of $9.95+ via the app or site. Bay Area locations in SF, the Peninsula and South Bay.

coupons.title: Luxe Cravings Boxes at $5, $7 & $9
coupons.description: Luxe Cravings Boxes come in $5, $7, and $9 tiers loaded with fan favorites for a value meal. Rewards members can also build their own box in the app. Watch the app for Tuesday Drops with limited $1 Luxe Value Menu items.

coupons.title: Early Dine entrées from ~$10.99 + free VIP appetizer
coupons.description: Early Dine specials run weekdays 3-5 PM with steaks, ribs and chicken plates around $10.99-$12.99. Join the free VIP Club for a free appetizer, a birthday meal, and 2-4 exclusive offers per month.
coupons.eligibility: Early Dine hours; VIP Club for appetizer

coupons.title: Free Chips & Salsa or $3 off an appetizer (Rewards)
coupons.description: Join free TGI Fridays Rewards and every member gets free Chips & Salsa or $3 off an appetizer with every visit. Earn points toward free apps (75 pts) and free entrées (150 pts), plus app-only offers.

coupons.title: Bookable tasting menus & wine-country experiences (SF & Napa)
coupons.description: Tock lists prix-fixe tasting-menu reservations and special dining experiences across San Francisco (Lazy Bear, Sons & Daughters, Sorrel) and Napa (La Toque's Black Truffle Tasting Menu), plus 1,200+ wineries. (Tock venues are being folded into Resy in 2026.)

coupons.title: $1.05 featured oysters daily until 5pm
coupons.description: Embarcadero waterfront seafood restaurant Waterbar serves its $1.05 featured oyster of the day from open until 5pm daily - one of SF's classic happy-hour deals with Bay Bridge views.

coupons.title: $5 Biggie Bag + free Frosty offer in the app
coupons.description: The $5 Biggie Bag includes a Jr. Bacon Cheeseburger or Crispy Chicken Sandwich, 4-pc Nuggs, Jr. fries and a small drink. Wendy's runs a recurring app-only free small Frosty with Biggie Bag purchase promo each summer - check the app Offers tab.

coupons.title: Free 6-pc nuggets with any purchase every Wednesday (app)
coupons.description: Through the Wendy's app you can get free 6-piece nuggets with any purchase every Wednesday all year. The Offers tab also rotates $1 Dave's Single and BOGO breakfast deals.
coupons.eligibility: Wendy's app; every Wednesday; with any purchase

coupons.title: Rosé flat-price custom half case - save 15%-40% per bottle
coupons.description: Build a 6-bottle (half-case) Rosé flat-price case and save 15% to 40% per bottle versus shelf price. Cases can be shipped, locally delivered, or picked up; ships to many US states.

coupons.title: 6 Bottles of Summer Water Rosé - coupon bundle
coupons.description: Featured summer Rosé bundle (Summer Water and other roses) at a curated 6-bottle price with free shipping on 6+. Seasonal value pick for warm-weather sipping. Ships to most US states.

coupons.title: First order — $5 off + newsletter 500 points (ships)
coupons.description: First-time Flaviar customers get $5 off their initial order, and newsletter signup grants 500 points (~$1). Applies across spirits including rum (e.g., Zaya). Ships to select US states.
coupons.eligibility: 21+; new customers; ships to select US states

coupons.title: Angel pricing up to 60% off market on Sauvignon Blanc & more
coupons.description: Become a Naked Wines Angel ($40/month into your account) for member pricing up to 60% off market on independent-winemaker wines, including crisp NZ Sauvignon Blanc, plus a monthly gift bottle. Ships to most US states.
coupons.eligibility: Angel membership; 21+; ships to most US states

coupons.title: $20 off first eligible order (email signup)
coupons.description: Sign up for Wine.com emails to get $20 off your first eligible order - stack onto a Sauvignon Blanc or any qualifying purchase. Wine.com ships to most US states.
coupons.eligibility: New email subscribers; 21+; ships to most US states

coupons.title: Scotch — $5 off $50+ storewide (5OFF, ships)
coupons.description: $5 off storewide (min order ~$50) at Caskers, applicable to Scotch and other whiskey. Ships within the US where state law permits. Stackable value with the rotating no-code Special Deals section.
coupons.eligibility: 21+; ships within the US where permitted

coupons.title: 1Password — 14-Day Free Trial + Switch Credit from Other Managers
coupons.description: 1Password offers a 14-day free trial (Individual $3.99/mo, Families $5.99/mo for up to 5). Switching from another manager like Dashlane or Bitwarden earns credit for the remaining time on your current subscription.
coupons.eligibility: New users; switch credit for existing subscribers of other managers

coupons.title: Adobe Creative Cloud All Apps — 60% Off First Year ($19.99/mo)
coupons.description: Creative Cloud All Apps (20+ apps incl. Photoshop, Premiere, Illustrator, Firefly AI) is $19.99/month for the first year (60% off), then $29.99/month. Students/teachers get up to 71% off year one.

coupons.title: Backblaze Personal Backup — $99/yr Unlimited + 15-Day Free Trial
coupons.description: Backblaze Personal Backup offers unlimited cloud backup for one computer at $99/year (saving $9 vs monthly) or $189 for 2 years (saving $27). Starts with a 15-day free trial, no credit card required.

coupons.title: Bitdefender Total Security — $19.99 First Year (was $89.99)
coupons.description: Bitdefender Total Security drops to about $19.99 for the first year (down from $89.99), covering 5 devices across Windows, macOS, Android, and iOS. Top-rated malware protection.

coupons.title: Bluehost Shared Hosting — From $1.99/mo + Free Domain
coupons.description: Bluehost's Personal/Starter shared hosting starts at $1.99/month (up to ~60% off select shared plans) including a free domain for the first year. Discount applies automatically via the plan page.
coupons.eligibility: New customers; intro term; renews higher

coupons.title: Canva Pro — Free 30-Day Trial (then $120/yr, save $60)
coupons.description: Start a free 30-day Canva Pro trial, then continue at $119.99/year (effectively $10/month) — saving about $60 vs monthly billing. Includes Magic Studio AI, premium assets, and Brand Kit.
coupons.eligibility: New Canva Pro subscribers for the trial

coupons.title: ExpressVPN 2-Year — Up to 80% Off + 4 Months Free
coupons.description: ExpressVPN's best current offer: up to 80% off the 2-year Basic plan plus 4 months free. The annual plan also includes 3 free months (~$6.50/month). 30-day money-back guarantee.

coupons.title: Hostinger Web Hosting — Up to 75% Off + Extra 10% (CNHOSTFIRST)
coupons.description: Hostinger offers up to 75% off shared/web hosting and Website Builder plans with a free domain, plus an extra 10% off your first plan with code CNHOSTFIRST. Entry plans from ~$1.99/month on longer terms.
coupons.eligibility: New customers; longer terms for lowest price

coupons.title: McAfee Total Protection — $29.99 First Year (Save $80)
coupons.description: McAfee Total Protection is $29.99 for the first year (saving $80), including antivirus, Secure VPN, and scam protection across multiple devices. Renews at $84.99/year.

coupons.title: Microsoft 365 Family 12 Months — $99.99 (was $129.99)
